status: diagnostic comparison, not an accepted performance stage
scope: Current Sloppy binary and own library versus Dewy native and optional LTO compiler hosts. Binary hashes identify executables independently from checkout revisions. Own-library differences are included. Equivalent source algorithms use different line counts.
limitations: Shared-library variant omitted: current Sloppy requires __panic_unwrap_in absent from Dewy library.
No conclusion about all programs or all runtime kernels. Host load and CPU frequency vary; paired rotating samples mitigate but do not eliminate noise.
The last accepted whole-stage baseline remains cd07ea34.

report.method: Sequential fresh builds with rotating positions/directions, one emission worker, one discarded warmup; warm filesystem caches. CPU = child user + system. Phase times are wall times. Jo source is identical across compilers. Shared-library variants use Dewy library snapshot because Dewy requires runtime helpers absent from Sloppy. Source lines exclude libraries; the equivalent Dewy source has different formatting. Compare time per workload, not only LOC/s. Libraries/binaries are snapshotted.
